evidence.quote: We explore higher order cognition at the intersection between mind, brain, and body.
How do every day stressors impact our capacity for insight and problem solving?
our group approaches this question by integrating clues from many sources, including human behavior, brain activity, and autonomic function.
Our methods leverage recent advances in lightweight biometric sensors, virtual reality, eye tracking, EEG, as well as state of the art immersive Virtual Reality.

This unique collaboration between UC San Diego’s Swartz Center for Computational Neuroscience and the Arthur C. Clarke Center for Human Imagination has given rise to an interdisciplinary team of neuroscientists, computer scientists and artists
